items.summary: Fix the backend so that questions added via the `addQuestion` update function are included in the results returned by `getByTopic` and `getByYear` query functions. Currently, admin-added questions are stored separately and are not merged into the main question bank that category/topic filters query against. The backend must unify all questions (both hardcoded and admin-added) into a single source that all query functions (`getQuestions`, `getByTopic`, `getByYear`, and the random quiz set function) draw from.

Fix the frontend Topic Browser screen (`TopicBrowserScreen.tsx`) and any other screens that filter questions by topic or year to also include questions fetched from the backend (via `getAdminQuestions` or the unified question query), not only the local static `questions.ts` data. The topic/category filter UI must merge backend-stored questions with the local question bank so that admin-added questions are visible in the topic browser and year browser.
